body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> CHUNGYOUNG DIGITAL(www.e-dixcom.com) has presented its new portable speaker.
Wine-glass figure speaker ‘DS-268A’ which features FM radio receiver, 35mm-caliber speaker unit, and 3-inch subwoofer.
2.1 channel portable speaker, ‘DS-06’ which employs digital IC.
